content: systemfonts 1.3.2 (CRAN, 2026-03-05): system native font finding. Imports base64enc, grid, jsonlite, lifecycle, tools, utils. Suggests ggplot2, ragg, svglite. Used by ragg and svglite for font access. register_variant() enables condensed/thin font weight variants. Provides direct access to all installed system fonts by name in ggplot2 (base_family='FontName'). Modern replacement for older showtext approach. Companion to ragg.
